biggest_catch: In-store-only cash with an ID check: per-item payouts are small and the buy counter can reject anything it does not want, so bring a box, not a single book.
catches: Per-item offers are small - this is a volume game, not a big-ticket sale.
The store can decline anything; condition, demand, and overstock decide.
Government-issued ID is required for every sale.
Resale catch-all: value varies by condition and demand; quotes and market prices can change; fees or shipping can reduce your actual proceeds.

steps: Bring your items to a Half Price Books store (in-store only)
Staff evaluate them at the buy counter
timing: Cash paid on the spot after in-store evaluation; in-store only.
who_pays: Half Price Books - the store pays you directly at the buy counter, in cash.
who_qualifies: You must own the items, bring a valid government-issued ID (required for every sale), and visit a store in person - it is in-store only, no mail-in.
work_available: Yes - stores were buying in person as of 2026-09-23. But the buy counter can reject anything it does not want, and it is a volume game: per-item payouts are small.
what_gets_accepted: Staff evaluate at the buy counter; condition, demand, and overstock decide. They buy books, media, games, consoles, select electronics, collectibles, toys, memorabilia, and LEGO - bring boxes, not single books.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; no shipping since it is in-store only. Your unpaid time is the trip to the store with your box of items.
when_cash_arrives: Real cash on the spot after the buy-counter evaluation - in-store only, with your ID checked.
